data.narrative:
Greenroom Robotics is a Series A defense and security technology company founded by Harry Hubbert, Zac Pullen, and James Keane. The valuation analysis draws from a composite universe of 10 same-sector and adjacent-stage peers, comprising 8 private companies and 2 public entities (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS). Key private comparables include Singularity, NODA AI, Anduril Industries, Helsing, and Shield AI.

The peer-median method, the primary applicable triangulation approach given available data, anchors to a $1.0B median valuation across the 10-company cohort. The peer universe spans a wide range—from $125M floor to $3.0B ceiling—reflecting heterogeneity in stage and trajectory. Sample peers in the Series B stage include Dream Security ($3.0B), Harmattan AI ($1.4B), Code Metal ($1.2B), Castelion ($1.0B), and Defense Unicorns ($1.0B), all clustering above the Series A entry point.

The triangulated valuation range is $850M to $1.1B, with a $1.0B median point. This reflects downward stage discount from Series B comparables while accounting for Series A positioning within the defense tech sector. Key uncertainties include the absence of revenue, growth rate, or product maturity data; the compression of only one valuation method; and inherent volatility in pre-revenue defense tech valuations. Additional methods (revenue multiple, DCF, or transaction comps) would strengthen conviction in this range.
